def test_frame_link_cleanup_rechecks_cleaned_inside_lock() -> None: """ A cleanup completed before lock acquisition makes the outer cleanup return without touching retired state.
Contract: Complete a real cleanup at the acquisition boundary, after the outer live-state check. The outer call must recheck under the lock, preserve the cleaned-state refusal, and allow another cleanup call. Coordination is synchronous: no worker can time out or remain alive. """ class _CoordinatedLock: """Borrow the link and complete one cleanup before the first acquisition of an owned RLock."""
def __init__(self, link: FrameLink) -> None: """Keep the borrowed link, one RLock, and a one-shot cleanup trigger.""" self._link = link self._lock = threading.RLock() self._cleanup_before_entry = True
def __enter__(self) -> _CoordinatedLock: """Let a real cleanup finish once, then acquire; nested entry skips that trigger.""" if self._cleanup_before_entry: self._cleanup_before_entry = False self._link.cleanup() self._lock.acquire() return self
def __exit__( self, exc_type: Optional[Type[BaseException]], exc: Optional[BaseException], tb: Optional[TracebackType], ) -> None: """Release the matching acquisition, including when the cleanup body raises.""" self._lock.release()
link = FrameLink( frame_name="ops", source_kind="frame", source_id="ops", ) link._lock = _CoordinatedLock(link)
link.cleanup() assert link.cleaned is True with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="already been cleaned"): link.metadata > link.cleanup()
